problem.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
problem.statement: Given a string s, return the length of the longest substring that contains no repeated characters.
problem.constraints: 0 <= s.length <= 5 * 10^4; s may contain letters, digits, symbols and spaces.
problem.optimal_space: O(min(n, k)) for alphabet size k

events.text: String up to 5*10^4 chars, any ASCII including spaces. I want O(n). My plan is a sliding window with a map of each char's last index; on a repeat I move left past it. Can you check the idea before I code it?
That approach works and meets the target complexity. Watch the order of your updates.
When the repeated char was last seen before the current window starts, should left move at all?
Good catch to ask. Yes, that case matters; handle it explicitly before updating your state.
Before I write it, which edge cases matter: empty string, all same char, something like abba?
Those are the right ones to test; your plan covers them if the update order is right.
